`rungar` is the daemon and its command line in one binary. `rungar serve` runs the daemon; `rungar validate` and `rungar config` read a configuration file and need nothing else. Every other command asks the running daemon, through its socket, which root and the `rungar` group alone may use: run them with `sudo -u rungar`, or as root.

## Commands

### Running the daemon

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`rungar serve`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_serve" >}}) | Run the daemon. |

### Checking a configuration

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`rungar validate`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_validate" >}}) | Check a configuration file, without contacting GitHub or any provider. |
| [`rungar config`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_config" >}}) | Print a configuration file as the daemon would run it, in YAML. |
| [`rungar config migrate`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_config_migrate" >}}) | Rewrite a configuration file for this version of Rungar. |

### Seeing what the daemon does

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`rungar status`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_status" >}}) | Show what the daemon is doing: its scale sets, providers and runners. |
| [`rungar events`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_events" >}}) | Show what the daemon has done to runners, providers and scale sets, and why. |

### Changing what the daemon does

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`rungar scale-sets`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_scale-sets" >}}) | List, inspect, pause, resume and remove scale sets. |
| [`rungar scale-sets inspect`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_scale-sets_inspect" >}}) | Show one scale set: in the configuration, in the daemon, on GitHub, and its runners. |
| [`rungar scale-sets ls`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_scale-sets_ls" >}}) | List the configured scale sets, and those found only by their runners. |
| [`rungar scale-sets pause`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_scale-sets_pause" >}}) | Stop a scale set taking jobs, leaving its busy runners to finish. |
| [`rungar scale-sets resume`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_scale-sets_resume" >}}) | Have a paused scale set take jobs again. |
| [`rungar scale-sets rm`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_scale-sets_rm" >}}) | Remove a scale set that is no longer configured: its runners, then the scale set on GitHub. |
| [`rungar providers`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers" >}}) | List, inspect, disable, drain and enable providers. |
| [`rungar providers disable`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_disable" >}}) | Take a provider out of placement, leaving its runners to finish. |
| [`rungar providers drain`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_drain" >}}) | Disable a provider, and wait until its runners are gone. |
| [`rungar providers enable`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_enable" >}}) | Put a provider back into placement. |
| [`rungar providers inspect`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_inspect" >}}) | Show one provider: its status, the scale sets on it, and its runners. |
| [`rungar providers ls`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_ls" >}}) | List providers: their status, runners, weight and scale sets. |
| [`rungar runners`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_runners" >}}) | List and remove runners. |
| [`rungar runners ls`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_runners_ls" >}}) | List runners: their machines, what the daemon knows of them, what GitHub says, and their jobs. |
| [`rungar runners rm`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_runners_rm" >}}) | Remove runners, the safe way round. |
| [`rungar reconcile`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_reconcile" >}}) | Have the daemon compare scale sets with the fleet now. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |

The commands that ask the daemon take `--socket`; every command takes `-h`, `--help`.

`rungar --version` prints the version.
